summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an accompanying press release announcing a collaboration with Vertiv, a critical digital infrastructure provider, to deepen technical supply chain capabilities for AI and high-performance computing data centers. The filing describes a non-binding operational partnership to leverage Vertiv's power, thermal management, and liquid cooling expertise. No financial terms, equity stakes, or transaction consideration were disclosed. This is an ordinary business development announcement, not a special-situation corporate event. The collaboration is part of Bitzero's ongoing ecosystem expansion with infrastructure partners and does not trigger classification under any special-situation category.
